title: Remove the fine-tuning tools
description: Deletes the training environment and llama.cpp's scripts. Jobs, datasets and finished adapters are kept unless you choose to delete them too. Models already registered with Ollama are not touched.

deleteJobs.description: Also delete datasets, jobs, checkpoints and adapters.

steps.title: Delete the training environment
steps.why: About 2 GB in your home folder.

steps.title: Delete datasets, jobs and adapters
steps.why: You chose to delete them. Running jobs are stopped first.
steps.run:
D="$P_HOME/.local/share/llmwizard"
for p in "$D"/training/jobs/*/pid; do [ -f "$p" ] && kill "$(cat "$p")" 2>/dev/null || true; done
rm -rf "$D/training/jobs" "$D/training/datasets" "$D/training/adapters" "$D/training/hf"
